inputs.name: network
inputs.description: Network the tunnel addresses come from, such as "10.77.0.0/24". Hosts without a tunnel_ip are numbered from it in order of name.

inputs.name: hub
inputs.description: Name of the host the others connect through. When null, every host connects to every other.

inputs.name: listen_port
inputs.description: UDP port WireGuard listens on, on every host.

inputs.name: persistent_keepalive
inputs.description: Seconds between keepalive packets to each peer, such as 25, which keeps a NAT mapping open for a host behind one. 0 sends none.

inputs.name: mtu
inputs.description: MTU of the wg0 interface. When null, wg-quick works it out from the route to each endpoint.

inputs.name: extra_peers
inputs.description: Peers Conn3x doesn't manage, such as laptops and phones, by name. Each has its own public key and tunnel_ip, and optionally networks behind it in allowed_ips and an endpoint. They peer with every host, or with the hub alone.
